data.body:
[P2] Retain cleanup failures after an MDC restoration fatal

After a successful body on an asynchronous executor, `supplyHandler()` can publish an MDC restoration fatal solely through the root completion future. Both `originalFailure` and `getInvocationFatal()` are then null here. If owned shutdown throws another fatal, it becomes `finalFailure`, but `DurableExecutor.execute()` rethrows `completedFailure` first and discards the shutdown failure. Subsequent finalization does nothing because `cleanupFinished` is already set. Combine the completed-root fatal with finalization failures before rethrowing, or record it before owned shutdown. Add a regression covering asynchronous MDC restoration followed by failing owned cleanup.
